fullDescription: Renders the dashboard-home view in its default state at the root route and keeps the screen composition separate from reusable dashboard UI.

Presents a three-column dashboard-home screen with a global header, repository sidebar, prompt composer, feed cards, and a right rail for event and changelog content. Supports the default state through props for user name, search placeholder, repository lists, and changelog items while keeping visible controls interactive with local state for prompt text, repository filtering, feed filtering, and repository scope selection.
